consent.poolLimit: The search reached its capacity limit. Results are incomplete. Narrow your job preferences to start a new search.
consent.title: Optional AI for cover letters
consent.explanation: Choose separately which providers may process your profile and the job ad to create letters. Job search and your profile work if you decline. Withdraw here or on the privacy page at any time. Withdrawal stops new calls but cannot recall data already sent. Contact us for erasure at the recipient.
consent.allow: I consent to the described processing by this provider.
consent.unavailable: This provider has not been enabled with reviewed information.
consent.changed: The notice has changed or the provider is disabled. Previous consent does not allow new calls.
consent.error: Could not load or save your choices. Check your sign-in and reload to retry. No new consent has been confirmed.
consent.generateError: The letter could not be created. Check your consent above and try again later. The provider may be unavailable or the usage limit reached.
consent.jobError: Could not load the job ad. Please try again later.
consent.careerScope: Optional: select up to three career entries. Only type, title, organization, dates and skills are sent with your profile. Descriptions and other narrative career fields are not sent.
consent.emailNote: The message is sent only when you send it in your email application. Avoid sensitive information.

privacy.title: Privacy and personal data
privacy.pending: The complete privacy notice has not been published yet. The service is not ready for public launch until the responsible organization completes this information.
privacy.exportScope: Signed-in users can download account identity, profile and career facts, plus favorites in this browser. The export excludes provider logs, backups and data in other browsers. Contact us for a complete access request.
privacy.exportError: The export could not be completed. Check that you are signed in and try again, or contact us.
privacy.rightsDetails: Contact the responsible organization about access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability. You may also complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection. Applicable rights depend on the processing.
privacy.contactPending: The privacy contact has not been configured yet. This must be resolved before public launch.
privacy.profileConflict: The profile changed after you opened it. Copy your changes and reload the page before saving again.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Need help? We're here for you.
support.cardFaqDesc: Find answers to the most common questions about Aplifyr.
support.cardContactDesc: Send us a message and we'll reply within 24 hours.
support.faq1a: Aplifyr analyses your profile and compares it against job listings to give you a grade (A, B or C) based on how well you match.
support.faq2q: How do I add a new job?
support.faq2a: Go to the All Jobs page and use the upload feature to add a job listing manually or via a link.
support.faq3q: Can I change the app language?
support.faq3a: Yes! Click the language switcher (EN/SV) at the bottom of the sidebar to toggle between English and Swedish.
support.faq4q: How do I remove a job from the list?
support.faq4a: Open the job and select Remove. The job will be deleted from your list immediately.
support.formSuccessDesc: We'll get back to you within 24 hours.
support.unavailable: The contact form is not connected yet. Messages cannot be sent here.

work.heading: Your work experience
work.intro: Collect jobs, internships, freelance and volunteer work. Describe your responsibilities, achievements and what you learned.
work.empty: Which experiences would you like to highlight?
work.emptyHint: Start with your most recent job or internship. Describe what you did, what it achieved and what you learned.
work.title: Job title
work.descriptionHint: Describe your main tasks, responsibilities and the tools you used.
work.achievementsHint: What did you improve or deliver? Use concrete examples and figures when you know them. You can write one point per line.
work.learnedHint: Which knowledge and ways of working did you develop in this role?
work.strengthsHint: Describe a situation that demonstrates teamwork, problem-solving or leadership, for example.

education.heading: Your education
education.intro: Collect education, courses and certifications, along with what you learned.
education.emptyHint: Add a programme or course. Projects, internships and independent work can demonstrate your abilities even when you are starting your career.
education.title: Programme or course
education.descriptionHint: Describe the focus and subjects. State if you finished without a degree.
education.achievementsHint: What did you create, investigate or complete? Describe your own contribution and the outcome.
education.learnedHint: Which methods, tools and practical skills did you learn?
education.strengthsHint: Give examples of developing analytical thinking, independence or collaboration.

preferences.title: Job preferences
preferences.intro: Tell us which jobs you want. Your saved choices are used to rank jobs on the home page.
preferences.rolesHelp: Enter up to 20 roles, separated by commas. Be specific. Your profile title is used when no roles are set.
preferences.locationHelp: Your home location helps us assess where jobs are based.
preferences.scopeHelp: Select the areas you are open to. Multiple choices broaden your search. Nearby is assessed within the same region; exact commuting distance is not calculated. Remote work uses the information in the ad.
preferences.skillsHelp: Your profile skills help matching prioritize relevant ads.
preferences.error: Could not save. Your changes are still here — please try again.
preferences.invalid: Enter up to 20 roles of up to 100 characters each and a location of up to 200 characters.
preferences.unavailable: Could not load your profile. Reload the page and try again.
preferences.conflict: The profile changed in another view. Copy your changes and reload the page before saving again.

cv.description: Build an ATS-friendly CV from your saved profile for this job.
